classification.rationale: Valve heads, coupling heads and faucet spare parts are parts of taps and valves of heading 8481. L85265 treated a brass hand-operated coupler connector under 8481.80.10 and the part line 8481.90.1000 for copper. The suffix depends on the material, assumed to be brass.
